# yarn-osv-audit

Audit Yarn Classic (v1) lockfiles against the OSV.dev vulnerability database. Zero runtime dependencies. Replaces the broken `yarn audit` command.

## Install

```bash
yarn add -D yarn-osv-audit
```

## Usage

```bash
# Scan using .osv-audit.jsonc in project root (created automatically with defaults if missing)
yarn-osv-audit

# Use a specific config file
yarn-osv-audit --config .osv-audit.ci.jsonc
```

Add to package.json:

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "audit": "yarn-osv-audit"
  }
}
```

## CLI Flags

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--config`, `-c <path>` | Path to config file (default: `.osv-audit.jsonc`) |
| `--format <fmt>` | Output format: `compact`, `table`, `json`, `summary`. Overrides config. |
| `--interactive`, `-i` | After reporting, prompt per vulnerability (y/N/q) to append it to the config's `allowlist`. Preserves JSONC comments. TTY only. |
| `--verbose`, `-v` | Log diagnostic details to stderr (parsed packages, OSV results, skip-dev trace) |
| `--help` | Show help |
| `--version` | Show version |

## Config File (.osv-audit.jsonc)

Most configuration is via `.osv-audit.jsonc` (JSON with comments). CLI flags: `--config` / `-c`, `--format`, `--interactive` / `-i`, `--verbose` / `-v`, `--help`, `--version`.

```jsonc
{
  // Severity threshold — set ONE to true. Fails on that level and above.
  // Default: "low": true (all vulnerabilities fail)
  "low": false,
  "moderate": false,
  "high": true,        // fail on high + critical
  "critical": false,

  // Allowlist vulnerabilities to ignore
  "allowlist": [
    "GHSA-xxxx-yyyy-zzzz",
    {
      "id": "GHSA-aaaa-bbbb-cccc",
      "reason": "Not exploitable in our usage"
    },
    {
      "id": "GHSA-mmmm-nnnn-oooo",
      "path": "express>body-parser>qs",
      "reason": "Only affects query string parsing"
    }
  ],

  // Output: "compact" (CI-friendly blocks), "table" (bordered table, default locally),
  //         "json" (CI/tooling), "summary" (one-line).
  // If unset: auto — "compact" when CI env var is set, else "table".
  "output-format": "table",

  // Show vulnerability details / stale allowlist entries
  "show-found": true,
  "show-not-found": true,

  // Exclude devDependencies (production tree = dependencies + optionalDependencies)
  "skip-dev": false,

  // File paths
  "lockfile": "yarn.lock",
  "package-json": "package.json",

  // Network retries
  "retry-count": 3
}
```

## Severity Threshold

| Config Setting    | Fails On                        |
|-------------------|---------------------------------|
| `"low": true`     | Low, Moderate, High, Critical   |
| `"moderate": true` | Moderate, High, Critical       |
| `"high": true`    | High, Critical                  |
| `"critical": true` | Critical only                  |

Severity derived from CVSS v3 scores: Low (0.1-3.9), Moderate (4.0-6.9), High (7.0-8.9), Critical (9.0-10.0).

## Exit Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 0    | No vulnerabilities found (at or above threshold) |
| 1    | Vulnerabilities found (at or above threshold) |
| 2    | Runtime error (network, parse, invalid args) |

## Output Formats

Format precedence: `--format` CLI flag > explicit `output-format` in config > auto (`compact` when `CI` env is set, else `table`).

### compact

One vulnerability per block. No borders, no column wrapping — renders correctly at any terminal width and in CI log viewers (GitHub/GitLab). Colour auto-enables on a TTY and auto-disables when `CI=true`, `NO_COLOR` is set, or stdout isn't a TTY. `FORCE_COLOR` overrides TTY detection (but `NO_COLOR` still wins).

```
Found 2 vulnerabilities in 847 packages

[HIGH · cvss 7.5] socket.io@4.5.0
  GHSA-677m-j7p3-52f9 — Unbounded binary attachments DoS
  Path: app > socket.io
  Fixed in: 4.2.6
  https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-677m-j7p3-52f9

Summary: 2 vulnerabilities (0 critical · 1 high · 1 moderate · 0 low)
Stale allowlist (2): GHSA-37ch-88jc-xwx2, GHSA-48c2-rrv3-qjmp
```

Dependency paths are traced from `package.json` (dependencies + devDependencies + optionalDependencies) through the lockfile graph. Up to 3 paths are shown per vulnerability, then `…and N more`.

### table (legacy, `--format table`)

The old bordered Unicode table. Assumes a wide terminal; wraps poorly in CI log viewers. Kept for users who want it.

### JSON Output Format

When `"output-format": "json"`:

```json
{
  "vulnerabilities": [
    {
      "id": "GHSA-xxxx-yyyy-zzzz",
      "aliases": ["CVE-2024-12345"],
      "summary": "Description of the vulnerability",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "cvss": 7.5,
      "package": "package-name",
      "installedVersion": "1.0.0",
      "fixedVersion": "1.0.1",
      "url": "https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-xxxx-yyyy-zzzz"
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "packagesScanned": 847,
    "vulnerabilitiesFound": 1,
    "severityCounts": {
      "critical": 0,
      "high": 1,
      "moderate": 0,
      "low": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## Requirements

- Node.js >= 18
- Yarn v1 lockfile (yarn.lock)
